first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon geometry for an unused Exeter listed-building record, with returned coordinates bound to explicit record-level Name/type-use and heritage fields. The selected GOV.UK API Catalogue entry confirms Historic England's official NHLE FeatureServer, including listed-building polygons, British National Grid spatial reference, Open Government Licence and daily-updated service coverage, but this catalogue window exposes no individual Exeter feature payload or polygon coordinates; therefore source-area metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
